tagline: Horror stories told for the dark. Full tellings and their chilling Shorts from Dark Tales Retold.

guides.title: Listening After Dark
guides.body: The full tellings under Videos are made for lights out listening: one story, told end to end. The Shorts are single chilling moments cut from the tellings, a minute or so each, for when you only want one scare before sleep.

guides.title: The Tell-Tale Heart, Two Ways
guides.body: The channel's Poe telling exists twice in this list: the full horror story, and a Short cut of its most famous moment, the beating under the floorboards. Start with whichever length fits your night; the full story is the one to hear whole.

guides.title: How To Use This App
guides.body: Every video on the channel is listed here, newest first. Search by a word in the title. Tap any video to watch it on YouTube, and tap the star to save a favorite. The list refreshes itself from the channel feed when you open the app, so new videos appear here with no app update.
